title: Pardon requires satisfaction somehow taken
source_text: III. Proinde sapientiae divinae visum non est peccata condonare, nisi justitiae foret satisfactum, & poena de peccato condigna quodammodo sumpta.
pass_a_gloss: Accordingly it did not seem good to divine wisdom to pardon sins unless justice were satisfied, and a condign penalty for sin somehow taken.
pass_b_english: Divine wisdom will not pardon without justice satisfied and a fitting penalty somehow exacted.
